summary.text: Tim Fleming is the Republican nominee for Georgia Secretary of State. A state representative from Covington and a business owner, he previously served as deputy secretary of state under Brian Kemp.

paragraphs.text: Fleming earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Georgia.
He served as deputy secretary of state under then-Secretary of State Brian Kemp and later as chief of staff to Kemp when Kemp was governor.
Fleming was first elected to the Georgia House in 2022 and represents District 114, which covers all of Morgan County and parts of Newton and Walton counties.
He recently chaired a legislative committee examining Georgia's election policies.
He won the Republican nomination in the June 16, 2026 runoff.
